meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求提交代码或调查 Git 历史时，Claude 会先分清任务类型、查看仓库现状，再按流程操作：提交时把改动拆成独立的小提交并沿用现有的提交信息风格；重写历史前先做安全检查；回答历史问题时给出命令依据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 Git 历史时触发（例如提交、rebase、blame 等）。普通代码编辑不会触发，除非你明确要求 Git 操作。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动分成两个提交，第一个是功能 A，第二个是重构。
查一下这个文件里 'timeout' 是哪次提交引入的。
say.note: Claude 用 git log -S 查找并给证据。

say.text: 把 feature 分支上最近的三个提交 squash 成一个。
say.note: Claude 会执行交互式 rebase 安全合并。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude handles Git commits and history research with a structured workflow: classifies the request, inspects repo state, then acts—atomic commits with detected message style, safety checks before history rewrites, and evidence-cited answers for history questions.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation (e.g., commit, rebase, blame). Not for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

say_en.text: Split these changes into two commits: first feature A, then refactor.
Which commit introduced 'timeout' in this file?
say_en.note: Claude uses git log -S and shows evidence.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits on feature into one.
